quote: This is not a gluten-free or celiac-safe restaurant. The house soba is nihachi (二八) soba, explicitly an 80% buckwheat / 20% wheat-flour blend, so the noodles themselves contain wheat.

The shop's OWN site spells it out: 「当店のそばはそば粉8割に対して、小麦粉2割のいわゆる二八そばです。」 Make http://www.adc-net.jp/hanamomo/ the primary citation and keep kyotopi as secondary.

note: UNCITED in the record (source is an empty string). Fully evidenceable — repair rather than delete. Both the daily early-morning stone-milling and the 20% wheat flour worked into the dough are on the record's own website; kyotopi corroborates the 毎朝 milling.

found: Shop menu: 「・にしんそば」「・鴨ざるそば」「・鴨なんばん」「・鴨ロース」「・板わさ」; おひるごはんセット = 「そばの実ごはんと焼みそ、じゃこ山椒、塩こぶ」; 「・とろろそば …（+50円で卵黄のせ出来ます）」

quote: This is a tempura specialist: items are coated in wheat-flour batter and deep-fried, so the food is not celiac-safe. A shared frying oil handling many wheat-battered items makes gluten cross-contamination effectively unavoidable.

note: Accurate. ADDITIONAL WHEAT VECTOR THE RECORD MISSES: the same page's keyword list includes 生麩 (nama-fu) alongside 活車海老 / 穴子 / 太刀魚. Nama-fu is pure wheat gluten, so a diner told only 'the batter is wheat' could still be served a 100%-gluten item. Add it to gf_detail.

Two soba shops in this same shard sit at 'no' on weaker grounds. Sending a celiac in to 'ask staff' at a katsu counter with nothing orderable is a wasted trip, not a lead. Downgrade, not an upgrade — no safety risk either way.

Minor: kyotokan prints a different address (錦小路通富小路西入東魚屋町182) from serai and Tabelog (河原町通四条上ル米屋町384-2, which matches the record's gmaps) — use it for the quote only, not for location.

RECORD VERDICT: repairable. 3 claims, all three UNCITED (source: null) and all three evidenceable — 3 wrong_source, 0 unsupported. TRADING: yes — 喫茶店百名店 2026 選出店, 3.63 / 689 reviews, reviews dated 2026/07, hours 11:00-17:00. gf_confidence 'ask' is defensible for a drinks-first kissaten (a celiac can drink here; 軽食はケーキのみ). vegan_status 'ask' is OVER-RATED and its detail text is factually wrong — see tier_recommendation.

why: vegan_detail currently tells a vegan 'Black coffee and similar drinks are plant-based and may be drinkable'. Two independent sources contradict that: serai says 「普通のホットコーヒーやブレンドコーヒーはメニューにない」 — plain hot and blend coffee are not on the menu at all — and kyotokan says ordering 「ホット珈琲ください」 brings you the whipped-cream Vienna coffee. The only food is cake (serai: 「軽食はケーキのみ」) and the menu file records 0 vegan items. 'Vegan — ask in advance' invites a vegan to make the trip on a premise the sources rule out. The detail text needs rewriting whichever tier the human gate settles on.
